violet: Heads-up: I'm doing a small "Edge Starter" quickstart refresh for serverless deploys (Vercel/Netlify). Problems we keep seeing: instructions show static API key usage, no guidance for token rotation/on-demand refresh, and the Vercel env snippet is outdated. I'll open a tiny PR to replace examples with DefaultCredentials + a token-refresh helper, add Vercel secret workflow, and a short 'first deploy' checklist.
omar: Nice. Can you include an example for rotating tokens using the SDK's refresh flow? People deploy and then wonder how to rotate without downtime.
violet: Yes. Plan to add a small helper:
```js
// token-rotation.js (serverless safe)
const creds = await DefaultCredentials.load();
const client = new RedwoodClient({ auth: creds });
// call refresh before cold start if token expires soon
await creds.refreshIfNeeded();
module.exports = client;
```
frank: Add a note: in serverless, do not call refresh on every invocation; check expiry and refresh proactively during warm-up. Also include guidance for storing secrets in Vercel: use Project Environment Variables, not inline in dashboard comments.
violet: I'll add Vercel example:
- go to Settings -> Environment Variables -> add REDWOOD_API_TOKEN (Production & Preview), then in vercel.json or runtime: process.env.REDWOOD_API_TOKEN
And a GH Actions snippet for Netlify CI: `NETLIFY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NETLIFY_TOKEN }}`.
sam: Can we also add a one-liner migration hint for SDK v4 -> v6? Folks keep opening issues when examples break. Something like: "upgrade package, replace old Client(opts) with new RedwoodClient({ auth: ... }), and update `getToken()` -> `creds.getAccessToken()`". Link to changelog.
violet: Good call. I'll add a subheading "Migrating from SDK v4" with those two bullets and a changelog link.
omar: Also include a short troubleshooting checklist for first deploy:
- Verify env var present in the deploy preview
- Confirm build logs don't leak tokens
- Ensure CORS is configured if you're calling from client-side code
- For server-side calls set serverless region to match model region to reduce latency
frank: Tiny UX nit: the sample's README still shows `console.log(process.env.REDWOOD_API_TOKEN)` in one place. Replace with a :no_entry_sign: warning and show `process.env.REDWOOD_API_TOKEN && useSecureStore()` instead.
violet: Yep will replace and add a warning box. Also adding a small code block for Vercel runtime usage: `const creds = await DefaultCredentials.load(); const client = new RedwoodClient({ auth: creds });` and note to use `edge` functions only when the model supports shorter latency.
preview-bot: Draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/743-edge-starter-serverless-auth-refresh  site-preview running (markdown-lint, link-check).
sam: I'll review copy and run the site preview. Please ensure the Vercel snippet uses `VERCEL_ENV` gating (Preview/Production) so people know which variables to set.
omar: After merge, add a short CHANGELOG line: "edge starter: serverless auth examples, token rotation helper, Vercel env guidance"
violet: Aiming to land before end of day. Thanks all :sparkles: if anything else pops up after CI I'll loop back.
